title: Transcript Coverage Analysis from Long Reads
author: David A Eccles
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.re2d3ge

steps.title: Create transcriptome index
steps.instruction: Use lastdb to create a transcriptome index from the transcriptome fasta file (Mus_musculus.GRCm38.cds.all.fa).

steps.title: Map reads to transcripts
steps.instruction: Map reads to Mmus transcripts using LAST, filter unlikely hits with last-map-probs, and convert to a one-line-per-mapping CSV format using the maf_bcsplit.pl script.

substeps.instruction: Process the CSV to ensure only one mapping per transcript-read pair.
Aggregate counts per transcript for samples: fwd_4T1_BC06, rev_4T1_BC06, fwd_4T1_BC07, and rev_4T1_BC07.

steps.title: Convert counts to narrow table
steps.instruction: In R, convert transcript counts into a narrow table containing Count, Transcript, and Direction columns.

substeps.instruction: For 'rev' samples, flip the Direction values ('-' to '+' and '+' to '-').
Create a barcode tag (DB) by combining the sample ID (removing '_4T1_') and the Direction.
Combine the processed data for all four samples (fwd_4T1_BC06, rev_4T1_BC06, fwd_4T1_BC07, rev_4T1_BC07) into a single data frame (trnCounts).

steps.title: Clean transcript IDs
steps.instruction: Remove the transcript revision number (if present) from the transcript ID using a regular expression (sub('\\.[0-9]+$', '', trnCounts$Transcript)).

steps.title: Load annotation file
steps.instruction: Load the Ensembl annotation file 'ensembl_mm10_geneFeatureLocations.txt.gz' into a data frame (ensembl.df) with columns: Transcript, Description, Start, End, Strand, Gene, and Chr.

steps.title: Format and join data
steps.instruction: Use the dplyr and tidyr packages to transform the data into a wide format and merge it with the annotation file.

substeps.instruction: Summarize counts and spread the DB column into separate columns.
Perform an inner join with ensembl.df by the 'Transcript' field.

steps.title: Handle missing data
steps.instruction: Replace missing data with a count of zero using the coalesce function for the following columns: WTfwd (BC06+), WTrev (BC06-), ρ0fwd (BC07+), and ρ0rev (BC07-).

steps.title: Calculate differential coverage
steps.instruction: Calculate the differential coverage (DCov) as a log2 fold change using a fudge factor (fcFudge = 5) to account for missing data.

substeps.instruction: For alignment to transcripts: Calculate DCov as round(log2(WTfwd + 5) - log2(ρ0fwd + 5), 1).
For alignment to genome sequences: Use the Strand column to determine whether to use fwd or rev counts: if Strand == 1, use (WTfwd, ρ0fwd); otherwise use (WTrev, ρ0rev).

steps.title: Export results
steps.instruction: Order the final table by the absolute value of the DCov statistic and write the results to a CSV file named 'wide_transcript_Counts_WTvsρ0.csv'.

substeps.instruction: Include columns: Transcript, WTfwd, WTrev, ρ0fwd, ρ0rev, DCov, Gene, Description, Chr, Start, and End.
